decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 2 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 3 - Before the development hereby permitted is commenced, details of fixing the proposed structure at the junction with the retained bridge wall shall have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority. The agreed scheme shall be implemented before the development is brought into use.
description: Upgrade of walkway under Kew Bridge, River Thames (Listed Building Application).
